mkdir -p programs; cat > programs/task-83e7fd37.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Enclosed rectangular frames: recolor their interior according to observed color rule.
    # Large frames are filled with border color minus one; 3x3 frames get center color +1.
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==9 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            cells=[]
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            # only rectangle perimeters
            perimeter={(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1) if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if set(cells)==perimeter and r1-r0>=2 and c1-c0>=2:
                fill=(color+1)%10 if r1-r0==2 and c1-c0==2 else (color-1)%10
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1): out[y][x]=fill
    return out
PY
